source.producer_commit_role: Original table-training producer, not the later diagnostic producer

scene.geometry_basis: Configured simulator geometry; measured board dimensions, provisional ball and bucket depth; not a reconstructed camera image

groups.label: bucket_first_miss
groups.description: First board rebound meets bucket before capture; contact alone does not prove a rim hit or entry.

groups.label: robot_first_miss
groups.description: First board rebound hits robot; later table/bucket motion is already deflected.

groups.label: setup_finite_ik_unresolved
groups.description: No admitted branch found within finite exact-action search; not proof of unreachable pose.

groups.label: setup_fixed_base_clearance_rejected
groups.description: Bucket/fixed-base clearance could not meet the unchanged conservative margin.

groups.label: table_first_miss
groups.description: First board rebound meets table; table contact is permitted. Later flight/entry still failed.

limitations: Former TEST positions are posthoc development cases, not a fresh evaluation.
First-flight crossing stops before first subsequent contact. It does not describe table-assisted later flight.
Force channel presence does not identify causal failure or prove an individual bucket/rim contact.
Saved endpoint shots do not validate driven arm transit; no new training or native trials in this diagnosis.
scope: Posthoc diagnosis of completed new PPO TEST outcomes; these positions are now development evidence.

diagnostic_evidence.scope: Source identity, accounting, exact proof binding and saved-trace checks. Not an independent native resimulation or independent scorer rerun.

parent_independent_native_audit.scope: Original complete native physics/geometry/scoring audit; its exact bytes are authenticated by the diagnostic producer.

rule.rule: Select first two sorted failures per first post-board contact class (table,bucket,robot), original tilt<22deg and board-bucket distance>=450mm; change only tilt to32deg
rule.assumption: Hypothesis from the shallow far failure family versus successful ~32deg table-contact family, not causal proof or a learned policy improvement

correction.interpretation: Tilt32 alone did not improve capture: every corrected request was declined before flight because the finite IK search found no board-arm branch. Zero corrected robot contacts reflects zero corrected releases, not improved clearance. Finite search failure does not prove all configurations at those buckets are infeasible.
correction.next_step: Find jointly admitted height/tilt configurations before more PPO; do not promote a tilt-only correction.
